AcceptanceCriterion.description: One independently verifiable condition for Task delivery.
AcceptanceCriterion.title: AcceptanceCriterion

AgentPermissions.description: The executable path, command, network, and state capabilities of an Agent.
AgentPermissions.title: AgentPermissions

AgentRole.description: Delivery-runtime roles bound to Task artifacts and state transitions.
AgentRole.title: AgentRole

BaselineExecutionFacts.description: Trusted collector output, never accepted from an API/model request body.
BaselineExecutionFacts.title: BaselineExecutionFacts

BaselineExecutionReservation.description: Exact current-call accounting, consumed only by the fenced queue service.
BaselineExecutionReservation.title: BaselineExecutionReservation

DeliveryFailureFacts.description: Facts from trusted application services, never model routing suggestions.
DeliveryFailureFacts.title: DeliveryFailureFacts

DeliveryResolution.description: A real engineering decision, sealed before queue consumption and never a verdict.
DeliveryResolution.title: DeliveryResolution

DeliveryWaitHandling.description: Immutable platform handling report, separate from execution and verdict.
DeliveryWaitHandling.title: DeliveryWaitHandling

DeliveryWaitInvestigation.description: Trusted collector observation. Request fields cannot assert stop or readiness.
DeliveryWaitInvestigation.title: DeliveryWaitInvestigation

EngineeringAdmission.description: One exact application of policy, distinct from RecoveryAuthorization.
EngineeringAdmission.title: EngineeringAdmission

EngineeringDispositionRecord.description: Durable compatibility decision; it never reopens an original terminal Task.
EngineeringDispositionRecord.title: EngineeringDispositionRecord

EngineeringPolicy.description: Versioned organization decision frozen only on newly admitted Tasks.
EngineeringPolicy.title: EngineeringPolicy

ExecutionBaselineBinding.description: One completed source rebind, never a role verdict or a new Product approval.
ExecutionBaselineBinding.title: ExecutionBaselineBinding

InterruptionContinuationPolicy.description: Frozen narrow capability; legacy Tasks have no implicit authorization.
InterruptionContinuationPolicy.title: InterruptionContinuationPolicy

LocalOperatorPrincipal.description: Trusted local composition identity; request/model text cannot add duties.
LocalOperatorPrincipal.title: LocalOperatorPrincipal

ModelSelection.description: Concrete, run-scoped model allocation with machine-readable reasons.
ModelSelection.title: ModelSelection

OriginalInvocationAuthority.description: Original producer identity from a real historical claim, never request text.
OriginalInvocationAuthority.title: OriginalInvocationAuthority

PytestSelection.description: A specific test function/class method, possibly parametrized; never a suite root.
PytestSelection.title: PytestSelection

RecoveryScopeRequest.description: Operator-selected exact missing files, bound to accepted Coder progress.
RecoveryScopeRequest.title: RecoveryScopeRequest

RetainedExecutionPatch.description:
Reference to complete old execution-base → candidate + dirty mutation bodies.

Trusted collection must validate the body and URI before this reference is
published. A digest alone never permits discarding a dirty worktree.
RetainedExecutionPatch.title: RetainedExecutionPatch

RoleAssignment.description: Temporary binding of an organization Agent to one Task role and lease.
RoleAssignment.title: RoleAssignment

Task.description: A bounded request tied to one repository and delivery state.
Task.title: Task

TaskConstraints.description: Machine-consumable restrictions attached to a Task.
TaskConstraints.title: TaskConstraints

TaskLease.description: Expiring claim on Agent capacity for one RoleAssignment.
TaskLease.title: TaskLease

VerificationRetryEvidence.description: A real inconclusive QA result on a retained candidate, never a code defect.
VerificationRetryEvidence.title: VerificationRetryEvidence

VerifierPreparationEvidence.description: Exact pre-model native execution facts, never an inferred provider failure.
VerifierPreparationEvidence.title: VerifierPreparationEvidence
